acceptanceCriteria: e2e-safe accepts --repository ID=DIR and binds each repository's revision and tree into the advice.
Coverage records and reviewed links can name ID:path, and a fixture selects a T test from an A change.
An unreached application path fails closed with e2e-unmapped-change.
Spec requirement(s) recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1078 (opened 2026-10-17). affected --selection-profile e2e-safe refuses --repository; changed paths come only from the root diff and application-flow-coverage/0 paths are root-relative, so a suite kept in its own repository cannot answer which browser tests an application change needs without dropping to strict/coverage profiles and losing e2e-safe guarantees. Request: accept --repository ID=DIR under e2e-safe with a per-repository base (or planning snapshot) bound into the advice; let coverage records and reviewed links name ID:path; a changed application path reached by no coverage record, reviewed link or impact edge is e2e-unmapped-change, failing closed as for root paths.
title: affected e2e-safe: select a separate test repository's tests from an application repository change (issue #1078)
